notes.title: Q.U.B.E. Create v1.0 Release!
notes.notes:
Q.U.B.E. Create v1.0 has released!

Everyone who owns Q.U.B.E. 10th Anniversary can now access Q.U.B.E. Create! 

Q.U.B.E. Create is free and bundled with Q.U.B.E. 10th Anniversary on Steam! So go grab it now and enjoy the remaster which includes a load of extras such as the soundtrack playable from within game, an essay on the story, additional levels, and access to the level editor, Q.U.B.E. Create!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1564220/QUBE_10th_Anniversary/

Bug/Crash Reporting

There is a dedicated Q.U.B.E. Create Bug Reporting channel in Discord and on the Steam Community Hub discussion board. Please post any issues in either of those channels. 

General Feedback

You can post general feedback and suggestions to the Create Feedback channels in either Discord or the Community Hub. 

Sharing Content

You are completely free to share screenshots and videos of your custom levels online, in the Community Hub, and on Discord. Tag #qubegame on socials! 

Join the Discord: https://discord.gg/ZSHz9kg9VV

notes.title: Q.U.B.E. 10th Anniversary collectors statue & physical box release?...
notes.notes:
What would you like to see next?

As we get ever closer to the release date of Q.U.B.E. 10th Anniversary, 
we wanted to give you the fans an opportunity to shape and influence this exciting release!

We're a small team behind the Q.U.B.E. games and this has been a project of pure passion and love for a game that means a lot to all of us, as well as to many of you! 
We've been overwhelmed at the outpouring of support, nostalgia and hype from the community so far, as well welcoming some lovely new faces who are just finding the games for the first time.

Now we wanted to give you all the opportunity to have your say on how the celebrate this amazing milestone release. 

It really would mean so much to us if you wouldn't mind taking a minute or two to fill out the survey below for us. 
This will help guide what we do for the next coming phases, behind the scenes! 

Links below
Take the quick survey here! - Please consider taking the survey, it would be a massive help.

Join the official Q.U.B.E. Discord! - Hang out with the awesome community and dev team.

Click here for a list of everywhere you can find the latest Q.U.B.E. news!  

Your comments and feedback have had and continue to have a direct impact on us shaping the game & we try to make sure every message gets read by the team.

Thanks again for all of the support & we can't wait for you to get your hands on the game.

Until next time!
- Toxic Games

notes.title: Update 1.5 is LIVE!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31518971/5a5c5f56c4dbc931fa267676a69b2ff7beb353ce.jpg

 Update 1.5 is Now Available 

Yes yes, we know. Another update.

Unfortunately, players were experiencing a few bugs which needed to be addressed immediately. Thank you to everyone for raising these issues and for your patience. We’re pleased to let you know that we’ve fixed the major issues as listed below:

- Fixed: Chapter Select Bug - This button would become inactive when completing the game. Users may need to replay the final level to now fix this by the Continue Game feature.
- Fixed: Level Skipping Bug - Player would not spawn in the correct place on next level load from the Main Menu. This would cause players to unintentionally skip large sections of the game, missing story and puzzles.
- Fixed: Left and Right arrow buttons on the keyboard would not rebind to any actions in the Controls menu.

Also, we have seen the requests for mouse keybindings so this will be addressed in a future update.

Hopefully you can now get back to enjoying the game!
A big shout out to || TITAN ||™ for another great screenshot!

Thanks,

Toxic Games!

notes.title: Update 1.4 Available Now!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31518971/1224223615a53241839820bd56a70a7f341e231c.png

Q.U.B.E. 2 Update 1.4 Available Now!

Hey guys, thanks for your feedback. There have been very few changes in this patch, but it was a required patch due to crashes in Chapter 9. 

Please see the list below for full details of this update:

- Fixed: Lowered the breakable barrier tolerance so that it works at low FPS in Chapter 10
- Fixed: Wires flowing direction
- Fixed: 'World's Apart' not loading from the Level Selection menu
- Fixed: Game crashing in Chapter 9
- Fixed: 'Ascension' not loading from the Level Selection menu

Apologies for the large patch size as we have made some changes on the backend that have caused this that may not reflect in the main game.

Thank you and keep enjoying the game!

notes.title: Update v1.3 is now LIVE!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31518971/175833438e6436beeb9aeaba22f50ac65ce4bcb2.png
Hey all, thanks again for all the feedback through Steam, emails and social media highlighting issues and requests for features.

Q.U.B.E. 2 v1.3 is now live and includes a Chapter Select Option!

Please see the list below for full details of this update:

-  MAJOR FEATURE ADDED: CHAPTER SELECT MENU OPTION 
You asked, we delivered. As definitely the most requested feature from our community, we have now added a Chapter Select option to Q.U.B.E. 2. Players will now be able to access and play their favourite levels again and again with the new Chapter Selection feature without impacting their current save game or completed save game. Simply go into the menu and you will see the Chapter Select option.

- Fixed: Nvidia Ansel not working.
- Fixed: Some UI elements still remain on screen when Ansel is active.
- Fixed: 'Apply' and 'Back' buttons should be in caps.
- Fixed: Default resolution should be the maximum support on current display screen.
- Fixed: Placement animation would sometimes get stuck on a loop.
- Added missing names and corrected some names in Credits roll.
- Added backend code to prepare for DLC packs.

Thank you and keep enjoying the game!
Also a shout out to || TITAN ||™ for the awesome screenshot!

notes.title: Update V1.2
notes.notes:
Hey guys, thanks for all of the feedback over the last two weeks through Steam forums, social media and emails regarding bugs and gameplay issues.

We’ve been working hard to resolve all of these bugs and we’ve just released an update that deals with these issues and takes your feedback onboard. 

Please see the list below for full details: 

- Added: Disable Auto Turn option. This option will prevent the player from automatically turning when launched by a blue cube. It can be found in the Accessibility menu.
- Added: Disable Camera Bob option. This option can be found in the Accessibility menu.
- Added: DLC menu added in the main menu for those who have bought DLC.

- Fixed: Rebinding controls causes use to get stuck on the keybinding menu.
- Fixed: Localization - LEFT in the keybinding menu was not localized.
- Fixed: When changing a setting in the Options menu other than Resolution, it would change the resolution to 1920x1080 or the highest supported resolution.
- Fixed: Increased default subtitle font size to 20, and increased subtitle size to 30 for resolutions above 1920px wide.
- Fixed: Sometimes cube types wouldn't attach to white surfaces, especially on moving platforms and later in the game.
- Fixed: Changed FOV range from 80 - 110.
- Fixed: Removed duplicate keybind for changing energy.
- Fixed: Pause menu chapter name and number sometimes disappearing.
- Fixed: Pressing left would return to tab selection in Options when using a gamepad.
- Fixed: Ambient audio was still audible in the main menu and other areas after setting all volume sliders to 0.
- Fixed: Slightly increased force needed to crush Physical Green Cube.
- Fixed: Collision bug causing players to get stuck under the world in the final puzzle rooms.
- Fixed: Disabled the Oculus Plugin as this was causing conflicts with starting the game on Steam. 

Thanks for the feedback once again and we hope you continue to enjoy the game!

notes.title: Q.U.B.E. 2's new trailer shows off its story ahead of March 13 release
notes.notes: Q.U.B.E., the 2012 game about manipulating blocks with high-tech gloves, attracted comparisons to Portal, but while its puzzles were smart it lacked the personality of Valve's classic. In Q.U.B.E. 2, story and personality will be a major focus, as Austin found out when he spent some time with it earlier this year, and that comes across in the latest trailer, above.The video starts off with what is presumably the first few moments of the game. Your character, archaeologist Amelia Cross, stumbles through a strange world full of swirling red dust, clueless as to how she got there. Eventually she makes contact with an ally over the radio, who will act as a guide for the game.The trailer also introduces what appears to be the game's antagonist force: an AI that sounds like it has bad intentions. "We know everything, Amelia," it rasps. The world itself looks very pretty, with environments that are much more adventurous than the clinical white rooms of the first game. Austin noted that Amelia's animations are much sharper, too, which will help the game feel more alive. Of course, it's the puzzles themselves that will make or break it. Early signs suggest they're interesting, but the challenge for developer Toxic Games is to keep coming up with new ideas throughout the 80-plus puzzles that the game offers. Q.U.B.E. 2 is out on March 13.
